title: drill dialog: a relationship-path condition shows as a locked chip reading "= [object Object]"
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the #36256 thread (PR #36461) on 2026-11-22 and measured by its dev. Filed by the seat, not claimed. It is the remainder of #36256, whose PR becomes `Part of #36256`.

## What happens

A dashboard or report drill whose dimension is a relationship path opens the drill dialog over the standard list with the right records, but the drilled condition shows as a locked chip whose value reads `[object Object]`. Measured live on HotCRM's industry donut (dimension `crm_account.industry`), 科技 slice, on the PR #36461 branch: the chip reads 「所属客户：= [object Object]」 with `data-field=crm_account`, and the list itself is right (3 rows, the 所属客户 column pinned). `readViewConditions` takes the nested object form in as a plain field triple, so the related field and its value are lost. (Corrected 2026-11-22: an earlier static reading said the chip reads "View filter".)

Measured causes:
- List rows lower to dotted AST fields, and objectql `assertFilterIsMaterializable` refuses a dotted relation path. Only the nested form `{ crm_account: { industry: V } }` executes, so an editable chip on that path is not possible today.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list` `conditionModel.ts` `readViewConditions` reads the nested-relation form as a field triple on the lookup (`crm_account`) whose value is the nested object, so `viewChipText` prints the lookup label and `[object Object]`.
- Neither plugin-grid nor plugin-list supports a dotted column, so the related value cannot be shown as a column either. PR #36461 adds the lookup field itself (`crm_account`, showing the account name) to the drill's default columns.

## What should happen

The drilled condition reads as a locked, labelled chip, for example "Account Industry: Technology". The label is built from the related object's field label and the option's label, in the reader's language.

## Done when

- `readViewConditions` reads the nested-relation form `{ <lookup>: { <field>: V } }` into a locked chip for `<lookup>.<field>`.
- `viewChipText` labels it from the lookup field's label plus the related object's field and option labels, translated, and falls back to the raw names when a label is missing.
- A pin covers the HotCRM `crm_account.industry` drill under en and zh-CN, plus one control showing a same-object condition is unchanged.
- No new public ListView prop. If one turns out to be needed, the claim says `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and names it.

Dedupe words: [object Object] chip, View filter chip, nested relation filter, crm_account.industry, readViewConditions.
